verdict.rationale: Twenty documents kanban board views with grouping and saved custom views (twenty-docs-34, twenty-docs-2), and deals carry a stage field, as shown by the 'when a deal reaches a certain stage' workflow example (twenty-docs-14). Custom fields with 20+ field types (twenty-docs-1) imply stages can be customized, and dashboards track pipeline metrics (twenty-docs-57). That covers the core of a visual deal pipeline, though no source spells out a pipeline or drag-and-drop explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of drag-and-drop stage updates on the kanban, explicit documentation of editing pipeline stages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the pipeline experience.
